training.selection: same search budget; each arm selects maximum weighted validation mean NDCG@3 across six positive goals; earliest ties
training.posterior: number of six positive feedback bits minus explicit hate bit
training.prior: seven frozen behavior probabilities oriented to utility; Jev adds inputs only
training.advantage: per-slate previous-epoch/current Mean@3 ratios on frozen behavior utilities; epsilon 1e-6
training.sample_weights: inverse inclusion weights normalized to training mean one

effect_gates.bootstrap_unit: paired user clusters, averaged over fixed fitted seeds
effect_gates.success: primary lower 95% CI > 0 and primary point gain > 0 in every seed, positive-goal mean lower CI >= 0, click lower CI >= -0.005, hate-risk increase upper CI <= 0.005

prospective_test.quotas_status: not final; inventory and development precision required before freezing
may_open_after: complete real development scores and audit
both arms complete equal-budget training and checkpoint selection
final sample and precision protocol frozen before any test performance evaluation

interpretation: offline logged-candidate ranking only; no causal business uplift or production RT claim
